description: Header file declaring functions and data structures for radio station monitoring in the WLD module, including initialization, destruction, debugging, and device retrieval functions.

methods.name: wld_radStaMon_updateActive
methods.description: Updates the active status of a radio station monitor.

methods.name: wld_radStaMon_init
methods.description: Initializes the radio station monitor for a given radio.

methods.name: wld_radStaMon_destroy
methods.description: Destroys or cleans up the radio station monitor for a given radio.

methods.name: wld_radStaMon_debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information for the radio station monitor.

methods.name: wld_rad_staMon_getNonAssociatedDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a non-associated device based on MAC address.

methods.name: wld_rad_staMon_getMonitorDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a monitor device based on MAC address.

methods.name: wld_rad_staMon_getDevice
methods.description: Gets a device from the device list using MAC address.

methods.name: wld_rad_staMon_getDeviceExt
methods.description: Gets a device from the device list using binary MAC address.

methods.name: wld_radio_updateNaStaMonitor
methods.description: Updates the non-associated station monitor for a radio.
